statement: PG wire password mode performs a real PostgreSQL credential exchange before session creation, correct credentials reach SQL through the production runtime listener, wrong or missing credentials fail closed, password mode refuses a missing credential verifier, and explicit trust mode remains loopback-only.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Password material must be supplied through the runtime credential-verifier boundary, must not be stored in runtime_config, emitted in logs, or accepted from a client-selected security context.
The existing trust mode remains explicit and loopback-only; this Quest must not widen it or make authentication implicit.
The declared scenario runs the real pg client against the production PostgresWireRuntimeModule listener and proves correct-password success plus wrong-password and missing-verifier rejection.
This Quest owns credential exchange only. TLS negotiation, certificate policy, and any claim that an external deployment is secure remain sealed to pgwire-tls-policy-cutover.
